thread:
maria: kicking off a cautious v2 slowpush in the 02:00 UTC quiet window. goal: validate streaming and routing header behavior with minimal customer exposure.

deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: id=rb-2026-03-22-01, initial canary=3%, stage windows=02:00-04:00 UTC, auto-fallback=enabled. will post status every 90s.

jia: will update release notes with a short migration note. callout: `x-redwood-version` optional header; older SDKs remain on v1 unless opt-in. also adding FAQ on how to force v1 in SDK.

sam: rollback triggers suggestion: sustained error_rate >= 0.8% for 4m OR 99p latency > 800ms for 3m -> automatic rollback. also watch streaming frame drops > 0.5% over 5m.

around: alex: add healthprobe for websocket streams. uses `ws-prober-v2` ping/pong + schema check. fail policy: 2 consecutive fails -> alert, 4 fails -> auto-pin.

maria: probe config: interval=25s, fail_threshold=4, grace=120s for auth jitter.

ops-bot: note: canary pool prewarmed to 8m to avoid cold starts, autoscale policy applied to v2-pool. alerting hooks wired to #eng-oncall.

rachel: docs update: migration FAQ + sample curl to opt-in: `curl -H "x-redwood-version: v2" ...` Add snippet about pinning: console -> routes -> pin to v1.

sam: pinlist for this stage: internal-only + low-volume partners. maria to push tenant_ids.

maria: pinlist: ["int-gamma","perf-small","partner-slow"]; external paid tenants excluded for now.

maria: deploy step (ops-approved):
```
deploybot start --job rb-2026-03-22-01 \\
  --route /api/v2 \\
  --canary 3 \\
  --probe ws-prober-v2 \\
  --fallback-policy auto-pin-on-failure
```

deploy-bot: canary starting, diverting 3% of eligible traffic to v2. snapshot links will appear in the console.

alex: monitors: v2_error_rate, v2_99p_latency, stream_frame_drop, cache_miss_rate, token_cost_delta. set ops-eyes threshold at error_rate > 0.4% for 1m.

sam: confirm rollback runbook: 1) deploy-bot pins route to v1; 2) scale down v2 pool; 3) incident triage; 4) decide to retry canary after fix. owners: maria, alex, sam.

jia: i've staged the release-note blurb and FAQ in the docs PR; will link once merged.

ops-bot: first snapshot uploaded: https://console.redwood/inference/canary/rb-2026-03-22-01/snapshots/1

maria: 15m update: steady. 99p latency 380ms, error_rate 0.05%, stream_frame_drop 0.02%, token_cost_delta +4%.

rachel: double-checking SDK behavior: older SDKs get v1 fallback. added a migration example for node/python.

alex: 45m update: all green. proposing expansion to 15% in next stage (same window) if no regressions in 1h.

sam: watch edge auth TTL — earlier staging run had 30s jitter causing transient 401s; bump probe grace to 3m for auth-related errors.

maria: increased probe auth grace. expanding to 15% internal in 20m.

deploy-bot: expansion applied: canary=15% (internal + low-volume partners). automations continue to monitor and auto-pin.

jia: updating release notes: v2 slowpush started, internal canary -> 15%, opt-in header available, SDKs <2.1 default to v1. migration FAQ link pending.

maria: final 2h check: metrics stable, no auto-pins triggered. scheduling public ramp in the next change window tomorrow. will share traffic schedule and customer comms before widen. thanks :thumbsup:
